questions.prompt: In which year did Singapore become an independent country?

source.note: Singapore separated from Malaysia on 9 August 1965. Check: National Archives of Singapore; National Library Board Infopedia.

questions.prompt: The Berlin Wall came down in 1989.

source.note: The border was opened on 9 November 1989. Check: Britannica, 'Berlin Wall'.

questions.prompt: In which year did Stamford Raffles land in Singapore?

source.note: Raffles landed on 28 January 1819. Check: National Library Board Infopedia, 'Stamford Raffles's landing in Singapore'.

questions.prompt: In which year did Singapore's MRT first carry passengers?

source.note: The first section, Yio Chu Kang to Toa Payoh, opened on 7 November 1987. Check: National Library Board Infopedia, 'Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) system'.

questions.prompt: Which ancient wonder stood on the island of Pharos?

source.note: The lighthouse stood on Pharos, off Alexandria in Egypt. Check: Britannica, 'Lighthouse of Alexandria'.
